ruling: ADR_UGENCE_STUDIO_FRONT_DOOR_SCOPING.md FD-3 COMPOSITION_RECORD_IN_REGISTRY: an ai-system-registry SystemRegistration; immutable and versioned by system_version; supersedes composition-record.seam-8.json; no new package for composition metadata

registration.notes: Front-door composition, seam 9 (FD-1 ONE_SEAM_PER_STEP, FD-13 as ruled: SCREEN_5_TYPED_VENDOR_DECLARATIONS, LOCAL_SQLITE_UNDER_RUNTIME_VOLUME, V2_AMENDMENT_TWO_OPERATIONS, RISK_POSTURE_UNINTERPRETED): build_studio_context receives one further seam, the tenant-bound SqliteVendorDeclarations file named by UGENCE_STUDIO_VENDOR_DECLARATIONS_PATH under the writable runtime volume (vendor-dependency 0.2.0), with the recording composition this deployment's name and version; the frozen v2 contract is amended a fifth time (v2-A5) by one write and one read; declare is the only write and the record confers nothing; the record carries an opaque vendor_ref and never an address, endpoint, credential, contract term or price; the risk posture is recorded verbatim and ordered, ranked and scored nowhere, and no vendor approval, onboarding status, tier or certification is expressible because no package computes one; the policy_ref is recorded and never resolved; no credential, LIVE path or egress destination is added, and decision_store, governance_hook and console_base_url stay absent. This is the last studio-alone seam under FD-1: with it the front door reaches its ceiling. Supersedes the seam-8 registration, which is never edited.
